verdict.rationale: Solid's components are plain functions you can organize however you like (solid-gh-14), and it ships built-in Context for sharing state across the tree (solid-gh-2, solid-gh-11), which is the framework's implicit dependency-injection path. However, the evidence never describes Context as a DI mechanism or shows provider/consumer patterns, scoping or overrides; the hands-on React port (solid-comm-4) speaks only to component reuse, not injection. missing for 10: explicit dependency-injection documentation (provider/consumer patterns, scoped overrides), guidance on structuring apps into modules, independent corroboration of DI-style usage.
